response.sql: WITH site_avgs AS (SELECT s.entrystat, sp.zoneref, AVG(sp.memusagegb) AS avg_ram, AVG(sp.procgpu::numeric / NULLIF(sp.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref WHERE sp.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.entrystat, sp.zoneref) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_site_ram_gb, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM site_avgs GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: The database is PostgreSQL, so `::` casts and NULLIF are valid. The GPU/CPU ratio is computed as numeric to avoid integer truncation.
A zero proccpu is treated as a missing value (NULLIF), so the ratio is skipped instead of raising a division-by-zero error.
Processing runs are linked to a site only through scanprocessing.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry, with an inner join so unmatched site codes are dropped.
Sites with a NULL entrystat form their own NULL group in the output rather than being excluded.
The per-site averages are averaged with equal weight per site (AVG over site averages), as the request specifies, not weighted by run count.
